verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents an AI Editor that lets users create and modify ingestion workflows with natural-language prompts. That is genuine natural-language operation, but only for one narrow part of the product. Other AI features, such as evidence validation, are automated checks rather than natural-language commands. The GitHub compliance skills run inside coding agents for PII and GDPR scans and do not operate the Sprinto platform. Missing for 10: a general natural-language or chat interface across the platform (controls, risks, vendors, audits, tasks), an agent or MCP-style command interface to Sprinto itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI Editor.
